items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: he’s included as one of three of the most important contributors in Mingus’ career. Danny Richmond, Eric Dolphy and Jimmy Knepper.

ctx.x: I read your little interview on line.

His daughter and my mother, his wife and daughter and my mother went to the same church. My mother still goes there. It’s a Unitarian church. And yeah, so they were friends. My mother was good friends with Jimmy’s wife, whatever. But anyway, time moved on and she passed but Jimmy’s daughter Robin was still there at the church with my mother and my mother — it just kind of came together and my mother, “You know who Jimmy Knepper is?” “Yeah, of course I know Jimmy Knepper.” His daughter goes here she has some…

heaviness in Jimmy’s work. So just the whole experience was unbelievable. And I was just caught in the wave you know. I had only known Jimmy — I never had a Jimmy Knepper record, maybe one. I had all the Mingus stuff because I’m a Mingus fanatic so I had all the Mingus stuff but — so it brought me really close to him as an artist.
